title: Reading
description: A single measurement published by one device. The contract between the Pi fleet and any consumer, including the web UI.

v.description: Schema version. Bumped only for breaking changes.

device.description: Which Pi sent this. Always present - the pre-v1 format had no device field, so two Pis publishing the same metric were indistinguishable.

value.description: A number for measurements, boolean for detectors. Strings only for text metrics such as ip_address.

ts.description: UTC, ISO-8601, milliseconds, trailing Z. Device-generated, so it can be wrong before NTP sync - see boot_id.

seq.description: Monotonic counter within one process run.

boot_id.description: Random per process start. A Pi has no real-time clock, so between boot and NTP sync its timestamps jump. (boot_id, seq) gives a correct ordering that ts alone cannot.

tags.description: Free-form extras, so nobody needs to add top-level fields.
